an-exceptional-battle-count-is: An exceptional battle count is a mega-account in itself. Applies above 20,000 battles.
cost-to-reach-the-same: Cost to reach the same garage through the in-game store
estimated-worth-of-the-account: Estimated worth of the account on the second-hand market
indicative-estimates-only-the-market: Indicative estimates only. The market value is modelled from prices of comparable accounts and is driven mostly by the account’s global rating (skill + activity) and battle count, with the garage as a small floor. Trading Wargaming accounts is against the game’s terms of service; these figures are for reference and we do not facilitate any sale.
marks-weighted-by-tier-3: Marks weighted by tier (3-marking a tier X is far harder than a tier V). 3 marks = €0.12 × tier, 2 marks = €0.03 × tier. Kept small: the skill is already priced by the rating below.
reward-tanks-add-a-little: Reward tanks add a little by tier. On the real market a stacked garage is only worth a few dozen euros, so this is a floor, not the driver.
the-real-driver-based-on: The real driver. Based on the WG global rating (Personal Rating), which blends skill, win rate and activity, and is the figure grey-market listings quote. Zero for an average account, rising steeply for strong ones.
the-real-money-cost-to: The real-money cost to research (free XP) and buy every tank on the account, premiums priced in gold. Far higher than the market value: the market barely pays for grind, only for what is rare or proven.
